title: Harden thumbnail cache: serialize pruning + fix byte accounting
description:
Follow-up from review of the storage-serialization work (commit 609fd4d).

1) MEDIUM — utils/thumbnailCache.js pruneThumbnails() does its own get(null) -> compute -> set/remove OUTSIDE the new storageMutationQueue. Two overlapping captures (e.g. Settings 'Refresh all thumbnails' racing an onActivated/onUpdated capture) can interleave and lose thumbnailCacheAccess updates or clobber an entry — the exact race class task 1 was meant to close. Route the access-map update + evictThumbnail through mutateStorageValue(ACCESS_KEY, ...) so prunes serialize.

2) MEDIUM (perf) — pruneThumbnails loads EVERY thumbnail's full data URL into memory via get(null) on every save just to sum sizes. Store per-key byte counts in the access map (e.g. { [key]: { t: lastAccess, b: bytes } }) so pruning needs only the small access map, not all blobs. Update tests/thumbnailCache.test.mjs for the new shape.

3) LOW — dataUrlBytes() uses value.length * 2 (UTF-16), but base64 data URLs are ASCII (~1 byte/char), so the 50MB cap effectively prunes at ~25MB. Use value.length.

4) LOW — workspaceManager.saveWorkspaceData() is now dead (no callers) and would clobber concurrent queued mutations if used; remove it or make its mutator merge rather than replace.

5) LOW — the async chrome.tabs.on* listeners in browserSearch.js initTabIndex await mutateStorageValue(...) with no .catch; a rejected mutation surfaces as an unhandled rejection in the service worker. Wrap/swallow.

Keep the existing test suite green.
label: Maintenance

activity.content:
Implemented the thumbnail-cache hardening follow-up.

- Serialized thumbnail saves, pruning, and eviction through the access-map mutation queue.
- Changed access metadata to `{ t, b }`, pruned from metadata without loading all thumbnail blobs, and corrected ASCII data URL byte accounting.
- Removed the unused unsafe `saveWorkspaceData` export.
- Swallowed queued mutation failures in all async tab event listeners.
- Updated thumbnail tests for the metadata shape and byte-based pruning.

Validation: `node --test tests/*.test.mjs` - 10 tests passed; `git diff --check` passed.
